title: Open-source basics: LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, templates
labels: documentation, good first issue
milestone: v1.2
state: open
---
`package.json` says **MIT**, but the repo has no `LICENSE` file, so legally the code isn't open source yet.

## Checklist
- [ ] `LICENSE` (MIT, © Amith / Zevox)
- [ ] `CONTRIBUTING.md` — how to run (`start.bat` / `npm start`), where things live (`main.js`, `renderer/`, `bridge.cs`, `devices.cs`), commit style
- [ ] `SECURITY.md` (see #[04])
- [ ] Issue templates (bug / feature) — added in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE`
- [ ] README: screenshots/GIF, install steps, known limits, credits
- [ ] Remove or archive `.github/issue-drafts/` after these issues are created
